_note: Placeholder lines for the M7 vertical slice (DESIGN.md 'The ending'). The Narrative Designer rewrites them with Aaron (M8 / M14); the cutscene system (M8) replaces the cards.

victory.caption: TRAIL CAM 03  02:14
victory.text: On trail cam after trail cam, the dead stop mid-stride, and fall.

victory.caption: GROUND ZERO  02:15
victory.text: The portal, humming all this time, flickers, and goes dark.

victory.caption: DAWN
victory.text: The comms room door opens. Ellen, Wyatt and Junie come out into the first light to meet you.

victory.speaker: Junie
victory.text: Is it over? Dad, is it really over?

victory.speaker: Ellen
victory.text: Whatever was coming through... it's quiet now. It's quiet.

victory.speaker: Wyatt
victory.text: We held it. All of us.

noReturn._note: Aaron (Session 9, #130): both charges on the hut. A radio call, then a pop-up: once they go off there's no reloading from dawn.

radio.speaker: Junie
radio.text: Dad? Are you sure you're ready? Once that hut goes she's got nowhere left to run. You'll have to finish her.

noReturn.title: POINT OF NO RETURN
noReturn.text: Both charges are on the hut. Once you set them off, the final battle begins and your save is deleted: you can't reload from dawn. Get clear, then set them off with the detonator (RT) when you're ready.

defeat.speaker: Ellen
defeat.text: Tom? Tom, can you hear me?
